findings.desc: B-9958 smoke does not directly prove default dry-run no-write behavior for the mutating writer surfaces. The smoke snapshots observe/no-mutation and checks drift failure writes no proposals, but it never snapshots stores around playbook_seed_propose_batch without apply, playbook_candidate_batch_approve without apply, or playbook_auto_promotion_apply dry-run. A regression that creates proposals/candidates or mutates learning state during default dry-run could slip while the current apply-path assertions still pass.
